gloss: trump card; ace up one's sleeve

definitions.explanation: The strongest card in a card game that can beat other cards.

definitions.gloss: trump card; ace up one's sleeve; decisive measure
definitions.explanation: A secret weapon, final resource, or decisive advantage held in reserve. The figurative usage is much more common than the literal card game meaning.

examples.japanese: まだ{切|き}り{札|ふだ}は{残|のこ}している。
examples.english: I still have a trump card left.

examples.japanese: {交渉|こうしょう}の{最後|さいご}に{切|き}り{札|ふだ}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: At the end of the negotiations, they played their trump card.

examples.japanese: この{新製品|しんせいひん}が{我|わ}が{社|しゃ}の{切|き}り{札|ふだ}になるだろう。
examples.english: This new product will probably be our company's trump card.

notes: Common collocations: {切|き}り{札|ふだ}を{切|き}る (to play one's trump card), {切|き}り{札|ふだ}を{出|だ}す (to bring out one's trump card), {最後|さいご}の{切|き}り{札|ふだ} (last resort). Almost always used figuratively in modern Japanese to mean a decisive advantage or hidden resource that can turn a situation around.
